description: This file defines classes and templates for implementing and managing codec interface parameters, including reflectors, helpers, and parameter builders, within the Android media codec framework.

classes.name: C2ReflectorHelper
classes.description: Helper class to implement parameter reflectors, allowing dynamic addition of structure descriptors.

classes.name: C2InterfaceHelper
classes.description: Base class providing API support for codec parameters, including parameter description, configuration, and dependency management.

classes.name: C2ParamRef
classes.description: Wrapper for references to shared parameter pointers, used internally in the interface helper.

classes.name: C2FieldHelper
classes.description: Contains information and methods for managing parameter fields, including supported and possible values.

classes.name: C2ParamHelper
classes.description: Manages individual parameter instances, including validation, dependencies, and configuration changes.

methods.name: describe
methods.description: Returns a descriptor for a given parameter index.

methods.name: addStructDescriptors
methods.description: Adds structure descriptors for parameter reflection.

methods.name: GetBaseOffset
methods.description: Calculates the base offset of a parameter field.

methods.name: findField
methods.description: Finds a field descriptor within a parameter.

methods.name: setSupportedValues
methods.description: Sets the supported values for a parameter field.

methods.name: getSupportedValues
methods.description: Retrieves the currently supported values for a field.

methods.name: getPossibleValues
methods.description: Retrieves the possible values for a field.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a parameter helper for a given parameter.

methods.name: F
methods.description: Creates a field helper for a specific parameter field.

methods.name: trySet
methods.description: Attempts to set a parameter value, returning status.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds and returns a shared pointer to a ParamHelper object.

methods.name: config
methods.description: Configures parameters, possibly updating internal state.
